ab.seg:
chos mngon pa'i mdzod kyi 'grel pa mngon pa'i rgyan ces bya ba | rgyal ba'i bstan pa lnga brgya pa phrag bdun pa'i mthar nye ba na ¦ shes bya rnaM par
'byed pa'i blo gros mtshungs pa med pas ¦ thub pa'i bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin cing | thugs rje dang 'phrin las kyi dpal 'byor bzang pos skye dgu rnaMs
smin cing grol bar mdzad pa bla ma daM pa chos kyi rgyal po rin po che dang ¦ shes bya'i nam mkha' la mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rgyas shing ¦ snyan grags kyi
'od zer gyis phyogs ma lus pa khyab par gyur pas ¦ sdoM brtson mkhas pa rnaMs kyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur cing ¦ gangsgang can gyi rgyud kyi gnas brtan chen
po mchims'chims thams cad mkhyen pa The identification of "mchims thams cad mkhyen pa" as "mchims nam mkha' grags" is tentative. la sogs pa'i zhabs kyi rdul rnyog pa med pa'i spyi bos len pa ¦ mang du thos pa shAkya'i dge slong 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis |
dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por dbu rtses nas Reading of "dbu rtse nas" uncertain. ¦ sa'i dbang phyug gi rgyal po chen po'i pho brang cong to'i mkhar du legs par grub par byas pa'o ||
